items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: I don’t want an Alexa. I don’t want her to hear — Alexa? ... I say, “Alexa, play Daryl Sherman” almost every night now

ctx.x: Well that says a lot. Now do you like to listen back to your own recordings?
At first no, and now I’m glad you asked because I’m not much for — I don’t want an Alexa. I don’t want her to hear — Alexa? You know what I mean?
